Leave the LEFT TWO-THIRDS open for the clean chalkboard. The teacher must NOT be centered. Medium shot, waist-up, eye-level. MOTION: The teacher faces the camera with a warm encouraging smile and clearly leads pronunciation practice. Use distinct follow-along teaching motion here: start with an open-palm cue toward the learner, then use two measured beat-count gestures with the hand, then an encouraging nod between words. Her mouth opens and closes naturally as if speaking each word slowly and clearly. Keep the motion patient and supportive, with subtle variation across the clip so it does not look like the same gesture looping. LIGHTING: Calm soft classroom lighting. FORMAT: Horizontal 16:9.
